text: DSH 开机动画与壁纸插件（Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 页面加入蓝调开机动画和主题背景。宿主通过同源路由提供包内视频与图片，浏览器模块负责播放浮层、壁纸层和设置页。功能包括可跳过的启动动画、三款壁纸选择、静态或动态背景、遮罩强度调整，以及动画开关和重播设置。适合想定制 DSH Web 启动画面与背景的用户；无需 API 密钥，偏好保存在浏览器存储中。

A DSH Web plugin with a skippable startup animation and themed wallpapers. The host serves bundled media; the browser adds the overlay, background, and settings page. Choose a wallpaper, set its motion and dimming, and control playback. No API key is required.

DSH 开机动画与壁纸的启动动画：打开页面时播放包内视频浮层，播放结束后淡出；用户可点击或按键跳过，并可在设置中关闭或立即重播。
DSH 开机动画与壁纸的壁纸选择：设置页可在三张随包图片间切换，也可选择不使用壁纸以保留原界面背景。
DSH 开机动画与壁纸的背景动效：可选静态、缓慢缩放或视频循环模式；系统偏好减少动态效果时会回退到静态背景。
DSH 开机动画与壁纸的背景遮罩：设置页提供 0 到 85 的范围滑块，调整壁纸与界面之间主题底色遮罩的浓度。
DSH 开机动画与壁纸的媒体服务：宿主注册同源前缀路由，为浏览器提供包内视频和图片资源，并支持 GET、HEAD、Range 和 ETag 缓存请求。

一个纯本地、不联网的 DSH Web 插件：把 `dsh-boot-clips` 里的 MP4 做成开机动画，并附带三张同主题壁纸。
宿主半（Node）只负责把包内媒体用同源路由发出去；浏览器半负责浮层播放、壁纸层和设置页。
section: DSH 开机动画 · 壁纸（男版）

text:
dsh-boot-animation-male README · 它做了什么：- **开机动画**：打开页面时整帧播放 8.6 秒 1080p 的蓝调开机动画，播完自动淡出。
  - 点击画面、按 `ESC` 或回车即可跳过；
  - 系统开启「减少动态效果」时自动跳过；
  - 默认每次打开 / 刷新页面都播放，设置里可改成「每个标签页只播一次」。
- **三张壁纸**：`觉醒` / `凝视` / `静默`，从同一段动画的定格帧里出，色调和动画一致；打包时已裁掉录制画面两侧的显示器边框。
- **壁纸动效**：`静态` / `缓慢缩放` / `视频循环` 三档。
  - 缓慢缩放：画面缓慢推近，并每 26 秒在三张壁纸之间淡入淡出轮播；
  - 视频循环：用同一段 MP4 做背景，结尾用两个 `<video>` 交叉淡入淡出，不会硬切；
  - 系统开启「减少动态效果」时自动退回静态，视频模式更耗电。
- **背景遮罩**：0–85% 可调，遮罩取当前主题的底色，深色 / 浅色主题下都不抢字。
- **全部本地**：偏好存在 `localStorage`，不上传、不联网、不读取用户目录。

dsh-boot-animation-male README · 安装：从 npm 安装（推荐；DSH 内「插件中心」一键装的也是这个）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-boot-animation-male
```

也可以从 GitHub 源码装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Apple-TWININGS/DEEPSEEK-HARNESS-Boot-Animation-Male-Version
```

本地已经 clone 的话，也可以直接装目录：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\path\to\DEEPSEEK-HARNESS-Boot-Animation-Male-Version"
```

装完刷新页面即可看到开机动画；设置页在 **设置 → 开机动画**。

dsh-boot-animation-male README · 安装：> 如果插件列表里没出现，把 `"dsh-boot-animation-male"` 加到该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`
> （或直接在 **设置 → 插件** 里启用）。装到别的 profile 时把 `web` 换成对应名字。

> npm 包：[`dsh-boot-animation-male`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-boot-animation-male)（当前 1.0.2）。

dsh-boot-animation-male README · 使用：打开 **设置（侧栏最下方）→ 开机动画**：

| 选项 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 启用开机动画 | 开 | 关掉后刷新不再播放 |
| 每次刷新都播放 | 开 | 关时每个标签页只在首次加载播放一次 |
| 播放声音 | 关 | 动画本身没有音轨，开启只是让浏览器尝试非静音自动播放 |
| 重新播放 | — | 立刻重播一次，方便预览 |
| 壁纸 | 觉醒 | 可选「不使用」保持原界面 |
| 壁纸动效 | 静态 | 静态 / 缓慢缩放 / 视频循环 |
| 背景遮罩 | 32% | 壁纸与界面之间的主题底色浓度 |

设置写在 `localStorage` 的两个键里，手动清理即可恢复默认：

```text
dsh-boot-animation-male:settings:v1
dsh-boot-animation-male:played:v1   # 本标签页是否已播过（sessionStorage）
```

dsh-boot-animation-male README · 兼容性：- **DSH**：`0.2.0-rc.2`（Web 端，`dsh web` 或桌面端）实测通过；
- **平台**：只有 Web 平台有 UI 半（`dsh.client.platform = "web"`），headless / TUI 里宿主半会静默不注册路由，不影响启动；
- **浏览器**：Chrome / Edge / Firefox 新版；Safari 需要支持 H.264 MP4；
- **资源体积**：`assets/boot.mp4` 4.4 MB + 三张壁纸约 0.9 MB，只在首次打开时拉取，之后走 `Cache-Control` + `ETag`。

dsh-boot-animation-male README · 权限与风险：- 宿主半只注册一条前缀路由 `GET|HEAD /dsh-boot-animation-male/*`，只发送包内 `assets/` 下的白名单扩展名文件，拒绝 `..`、反斜杠和目录逃逸；
- 支持 `Range`（视频边下边播）与 `ETag`（304 复用），不写任何文件、不访问外网、不读取用户目录；
- 不修改任何宿主配置；所有偏好都留在浏览器 `localStorage`；
- 与其它背景 / 开机动画插件**同时只开一个**：壁纸层都是 `z-index:-1`，后挂的会盖住先挂的；开机动画同理。

dsh-boot-animation-male README · 卸载：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-boot-animation-male
```

或在 **设置 → 插件** 里关掉 / 卸载本 bundle。

dsh-boot-animation-male README · 素材：- 动画与三张壁纸由 **Apple-TWININGS** 制作，随本仓库以 MIT 许可发布；原始剪辑留在 `dsh-boot-clips/`（不入包）。
- `静默` 取自动画收尾的闭目帧；`觉醒`、`凝视` 取自睁眼定格帧。
- 源素材是屏幕录制，左右有显示器边框 / 反光：打包的壁纸已裁掉左右边框，开机动画用 1.05 倍裁边把左边那条遮住。

dsh-boot-animation-male README · 目录结构：```text
.
├── index.js              # 宿主半：同源媒体路由（Range / ETag / 穿越防护）
├── client.js             # 浏览器半：开机动画浮层 + 壁纸层 + 设置页
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle 补丁：插入一行 boot-animation-male

dsh-boot-animation-male README · English：A local-only DeepSeek Harness Web plugin: an 8.6-second blue-toned boot animation (skippable) plus three matching wallpapers, with a settings page under **Settings → Boot animation**. See [README.en.md](README.en.md).

dsh-boot-animation-male README · DSH Boot Animation & Wallpapers (Male Version)：[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/apple-twinings/deepseek-harness-boot-animation-male-version)
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-boot-animation-male)

> **One line: install it, open DeepSeek Harness, watch an 8.6s DeepSeek-blue boot animation (skippable), then keep one of three matching wallpapers behind the UI.**

dsh-boot-animation-male README · DSH Boot Animation & Wallpapers (Male Version)：A fully local DeepSeek Harness Web plugin. The Host half serves the bundled media over one same-origin route; the Client half plays the full-frame overlay, paints the wallpaper layer at `z-index:-1`, and adds a settings page. No network access, no user-file reads, no host config writes.

dsh-boot-animation-male README · Features：- **Boot animation** — full-frame 8.6s 1080p clip on load, fades out when it ends.
  - Skip with a click, `ESC` or `Enter`; automatically skipped under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
  - Plays on every page load by default; a setting can limit it to once per tab.
- **Three wallpapers** — `Awake` / `Gaze` / `Silent`, frame-stills from the same animation, with the captured monitor bezel cropped out.
- **Wallpaper motion** — `Static` / `Slow zoom` / `Video loop`.
  - Slow zoom pushes in gently and cross-fades between the three wallpapers every 26s.
  - Video loop uses the same MP4 as a backdrop, with two `<video>` elements cross-fading at the loop point.
  - Falls back to static under `prefers-reduced-motion`; video decoding costs more battery.
- **Background veil** — 0–85%, tinted with the current theme base colour so text stays readable in light and dark themes.
- **No telemetry** — preferences live in `localStorage`.

dsh-boot-animation-male README · Install：From npm (recommended; this is also what the in-app plugin store installs):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-boot-animation-male
```

Or from the GitHub source:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Apple-TWININGS/DEEPSEEK-HARNESS-Boot-Animation-Male-Version
```

Or install a local checkout by directory:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\path\to\DEEPSEEK-HARNESS-Boot-Animation-Male-Version"
```

dsh-boot-animation-male README · Install：Reload the page to see the boot animation. Settings live under **Settings → Boot animation**.

> npm package: [`dsh-boot-animation-male`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-boot-animation-male) (currently 1.0.2).

> If the plugin does not show up, append `"dsh-boot-animation-male"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's
> `package.json` (or enable it under **Settings → Plugins**). Replace `web` with your profile name if different.

dsh-boot-animation-male README · Install：> The npm package `dsh-boot-animation-male` is not published yet. Once it is, the command becomes
> `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-boot-animation-male`, which is also what makes it appear in the in-app plugin store.

dsh-boot-animation-male README · Settings：| Option | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enable boot animation | on | Off: no overlay on load |
| Play on every reload | on | Off: first load of each tab only |
| Play with sound | off | The clip has no audio track |
| Play again | — | Replay immediately |
| Wallpaper | Awake | `None` keeps the default UI |
| Wallpaper motion | Static | Static / Slow zoom / Video loop |
| Background veil | 32% | Theme base colour between wallpaper and UI |
dsh-boot-animation-male README · Settings：Stored under `localStorage` keys `dsh-boot-animation-male:settings:v1` and `dsh-boot-animation-male:played:v1` (sessionStorage).

dsh-boot-animation-male README · Compatibility：- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, Web front end (`dsh web` or the desktop app).
- Web platform only; the Host half silently skips route registration where no `webServer` exists, so headless/TUI profiles still boot.
- Chrome / Edge / Firefox current versions; Safari needs H.264 MP4 support.
- 4.4 MB video + ~0.9 MB of wallpapers, fetched on first load, then cached via `Cache-Control` + `ETag`.

dsh-boot-animation-male README · Permissions and risks：- One prefix route `GET|HEAD /dsh-boot-animation-male/*` serving only whitelisted extensions from the package's `assets/`; `..`, backslashes and path escapes are rejected.
- `Range` support for seeking/streaming and `ETag` for 304 reuse. No file writes, no outbound requests, no user-directory reads.
- Only one background / boot plugin should be enabled at a time: wallpaper layers all sit at `z-index:-1`, so the last one installed wins.

dsh-boot-animation-male README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-boot-animation-male
```
